purpose: Compact, authoritative evidence package for generating a publication-quality methodology figure with another AI. Documentation/visualization extraction ONLY.

governance.sources_used: existing frozen artifacts, manifests, cached outputs, existing figures
governance.note: Panels 04/07 reuse EXISTING frozen probability caches; panel 05 draws EXISTING frozen GT-free ROI geometry. Panel 06 requires a new R_psi forward and is therefore omitted.

verified_four_domains.NOTE: The task-id order is ISIC=0, BUSI=1, KVASIR=2, KUB=3. This DIFFERS from an alphabetical/assumed order; it is the frozen authoritative mapping.
verified_four_domains.segmentation_class_note: Every domain is binary foreground/background. Domain/task id is NOT a segmentation class. Foreground = binarized mask (mask > 0).

TEST.note: TEST is CLOSED; counts are metadata only, never read or visualized.

global_medfilm_architecture.film_rule: F_hat = (1 + gamma) * F + beta ; gamma,beta = tanh(W e + b) ; zero-initialized output
global_medfilm_architecture.task_conditioning_entry_point: nn.Embedding(4, 32) ONLY - task_id is never concatenated, channelized, or routed to a per-domain head
global_medfilm_architecture.output_head: single shared nn.Conv2d(24, 1, kernel_size=1); no dataset-specific head

B_phi.architecture: nn.Embedding(4,16) + MLP[218 -> 128 -> 64 -> 1] with LayerNorm + SiLU + Dropout(0.10)

output_dimensions.interpretation: scalar delta_hat (paired refinement gain), Huber loss delta=0.05

B_phi.normalization: LayerNorm; input scalar normalization FIT-only, SCALAR_NORMALIZE_IDX=[192,193,194,195,196,197,200,201], ddof=0
B_phi.purpose: Predicts paired refinement gain BEFORE the refiner runs; decides SKIP vs EXECUTE.

R_psi.architecture: narrowed-channel residual U-Net; channels (16,32,64,96,128); GroupNorm + SiLU

output_dimensions.interpretation: single-channel raw logits, no internal sigmoid

R_psi.purpose: Refines the ROI crop into a higher-resolution regional probability.

S_omega.architecture: MLP Linear(20,32) -> SiLU -> Linear(32,16) -> SiLU -> Linear(16,1)

output_dimensions.interpretation: scalar safety logit; ACCEPT iff sigmoid(logit) >= 0.50

S_omega.purpose: Post-refinement safety gate; decides ACCEPT vs REJECT (fallback to global).

RAMedFiLMBARR_wrapper.note: Assembly-only. Adds NO parameters, NO learned layers, NO loss/optimizer/backward.

roi_generation.empty_proposal_behavior: ACTION_UNAVAILABLE -> FORCED_SKIP; router and refiner are not invoked
roi_generation.crop_resize_logic: canvas 512 -> crop -> resize to 256x256 for R_psi; effective magnification recorded per sample

representative_samples.selection_rule: Ordinary median-index VAL808 sample per domain (NOT cherry-picked best results). KUB selects a Kidney_Stone row near the domain median; the subgroup is reporting metadata only.
representative_samples.state_note: The chosen samples happen to cover BOTH branches (2 SKIP_GLOBAL, 2 EXECUTE_THEN_ACCEPT), which is useful for a methodology figure. 04 and 07 coincide for SKIP_GLOBAL samples because final = global there.
